sources.title: Sciopero delle farmacie private il 13 aprile. A Roma manifestazione nazionale per il rinnovo del contratto
sources.excerpt: Lunedì 13 aprile, le oltre 76mila farmaciste, farmacisti e collaboratori del settore incroceranno nuovamente le braccia
sources.provenance: Quotidiano Sanità, directly opened; publication date shown on page. The report describes a planned strike and march, not an after-action confirmation.

provisional_leads.assessment: Specific, dated labor mobilization lead, with described contract-renewal demands and a planned Rome march.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: Source is a pre-event notice, so occurrence and turnout remain unconfirmed.

provisional_leads.actors: Kering facility workers; Filctem CGIL, Femca CISL, Uiltec UIL

sources.title: Italian unions say there is '70% to 100%' participation in Kering strike
sources.excerpt: A strike at luxury group Kering's facilities in Italy was highly successful
sources.provenance: Reuters, article directly opened. The 70–100% participation estimate is attributed to the unions; workers opposed 54 planned job cuts at Alexander McQueen and complained about reorganization opacity.

provisional_leads.assessment: Strong provisional strike lead with same-day reporting; retain the turnout figure as a union claim.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: Article does not enumerate every affected facility or independently measure participation.

provisional_leads.actors: British Council teaching staff in Italy

sources.title: British Council staff in Italy to strike over proposed 80% workforce cut
sources.excerpt: Staff at the British Council in Italy will go on strike over deep cuts
sources.provenance: The Guardian, directly opened. Page states 108 of 130 teaching staff across three cities were targeted by proposed cuts; published on planned strike day.

provisional_leads.assessment: Credible news report of announced strike in response to a proposed major staff reduction.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: The accessible article is framed prospectively and does not confirm completion.

sources.title: Sciopero dei lavoratori della cultura oggi 12 giugno: le ragioni della mobilitazione
sources.excerpt: con manifestazioni in corso in 15 città
sources.provenance: Sky TG24, directly opened; page timestamp 12 June 2026 14:00. Reports presidi and strike in progress, including some Venice Biennale pavilions closed.

provisional_leads.assessment: Strong event-day reporting of national strike and public actions in 15 cities, around pay, protections, outsourcing and precarious contracts.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: Article reports the situation midday; it does not establish final participation or duration.
